page.notes: Hebrew words are printed in the text and are uncertain: the first (after "finem,") is read as יִךְ תמ, the second as את כמש הורת; both are doubtful. The Greek word in the note on "legis Mosis mischnam" is doubtful and marked [?]. The word "ementitę" carries a printed cedilla-like mark on the e; kept as printed. The text is set in italic and roman type with several passages in italic, all rendered as they appear in the scan.
